company_profile.company_stage: large public electric power and energy infrastructure company

sources.title: NextEra Energy company overview
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy publicly describes electric utility, renewable generation, energy infrastructure, reliability, and long-term investment in cleaner energy systems.

sources.title: NextEra Energy careers
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy careers material emphasizes safety, customer service, operational excellence, innovation, teamwork, and energy-sector impact.

sources.title: NextEra Energy about us: leaders and core values
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy states that its leaders embody core values of excellence, integrity, and respect, and frames its century-long history around innovation, customer value, and reliable energy solutions.

sources.title: Life at NextEra Energy: culture
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's culture page says success begins with people, describes attracting people with unique perspectives and experiences, commits to respect and an engaged team, and cites 14 employee resource groups as culture advisers.

sources.title: Life at NextEra Energy: innovation programs
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy describes continuous improvement as central to its identity and lists an annual Hack Week, an in-house startup innovation hub, an innovation summit, and AI-equipped drones used in power restoration.

sources.title: Getting hired at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's getting-hired page directs candidates to Edison Electric Institute sample employment tests and groups featured jobs by accounting and finance, engineering, IT, linework, nuclear, power delivery, and power generation.

sources.title: Sample employment test and retest policy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy says it uses consistently administered pre-employment tests designed by the Edison Electric Institute for several craft, clerical, and plant roles, and publishes a retest waiting period after unsuccessful attempts.

sources.title: Corporate jobs at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's corporate jobs page seeks bar-raising candidates committed to changing the world, emphasizes continuous learning and development, and describes finance, technology, engineering, customer service, and internship teams.

sources.title: Field jobs at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's field jobs page describes lineworkers, cable splicers, power delivery, power generation, and nuclear careers, and ties field work to reliable electricity for more than 12 million Florida customers.

sources.title: NextEra Energy internships
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy says most internships last 10 to 12 weeks, treats every intern as a potential full-time employee, requires a 3.00 GPA, full-time enrollment in a bachelor's program or higher, and U.S. work authorization, and posts summer roles from September to November with offers targeted by December to February.

sources.title: Military and veteran careers at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy says veterans strengthen its culture through life experience, discipline, creativity, and technical expertise, runs a Department of Defense SkillBridge program with on-the-job industry training, and supports a VETNEXT employee resource group for military families.

sources.title: NextEra Energy awards and recognition
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's awards page cites 2026 Forbes America's Best Large Employers, repeated Fortune Most Admired listings, and 2025 HIRE Vets Platinum recognition, presenting external employer and veteran-hiring recognition as evidence of its people proposition; these are company-reported awards.

sources.title: NextEra Energy employee scam alert
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy warns that criminals impersonate the company and its affiliates in employment scams, states it never asks candidates for money, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or payments, points to official email domains, and lists chat-only interviews as a scam indicator.

sources.title: NextEra Energy careers for recent graduates
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra's recent-graduate page separates entry paths: an Associate Engineer track for engineering graduates within the last five years, IT rotation programs, and a three-year finance and accounting leadership development program, each linked to its own job search.

sources.title: Ignite digital and data analytics programs
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra describes an Ignite Digital program of two years and four six-month rotations across application development, cloud, agile delivery, cybersecurity, data analytics, DevOps and infrastructure, plus a 12-month Ignite Data Analytics program requiring coding and a sample project portfolio, with two intakes a year.

sources.title: NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy proposed combination announcement
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's May 18, 2026 release describes an all-stock agreement to combine with Dominion Energy, expected to close in 12 to 18 months subject to shareholder votes, HSR review, and other regulatory approvals. It lists approval delays, failure to realize expected benefits, management distraction, and difficulty hiring or retaining employees as risks, and states post-close job, pay, and benefits protection for Dominion employees.

sources.title: NextEra Energy third-quarter 2026 earnings release
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra's Oct. 21, 2026 results report adjusted EPS of $1.24, up 9.7%, and a renewables and storage backlog of about 36.7 GW after adding 3.7 GW. Shareholders approved the Dominion combination on Sept. 3, state hearings run through early 2027, and closing is expected in the second half of 2027. The release ties 1,000 new Virginia jobs to approval and lists approval, integration, and retention risks.

sources.title: FPL emergency response plan for Tropical Storm Isaias
sources.public_safe_signal: FPL's Oct. 7, 2026 notice says it pre-positioned crews, sought mutual-assistance and contractor support, and monitored the system around the clock as Tropical Storm Isaias approached the Panhandle, warning of outages from rain, wind, flooding, surge, and tornadoes. It describes FPL as serving about 12 million people and cites ReliabilityOne recognition in eight of the last 11 years.

sources.title: Employee benefits at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra lists benefits beginning on day one: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) match and pension; health savings account; paid parental leave; tuition reimbursement; adoption assistance; employee assistance and well-being programs; and on-site fitness and medical services where available.

sources.title: Career growth at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra's career-growth page says it invests in development through courses, mentorship and special assignments, offers tuition assistance for undergraduate and master's degrees, and describes NextEra University as more than 1,500 courses open to all employees, including leadership and technical skills.

sources.title: Engineering jobs at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra's engineering careers page says engineers work across wind, solar, battery, nuclear, distribution and transmission. It lists process improvement against operational performance targets, predictive-monitoring and data-analysis applications for power plants, revised operating models, grid hardening, and cybersecurity and infrastructure-integrity troubleshooting.

sources.title: Information technology jobs at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra's technology careers page lists cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, computer science, database and systems management and systems operations. It describes work on cyber defence, robotics and machine-learning solutions, predictive analytics for grid and component health, and customer energy-usage experiences.

sources.title: Power delivery jobs at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra's power-delivery page says the team serves more than 12 million customers across 35,550 square miles and operates more than 880 substations and over 80,000 miles of distribution lines. It frames the work as designing a hardened grid and evaluating system performance and reliability strategy.

sources.title: NextEra data analytics program for recent graduates
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra's data-analytics program page describes a 12-month recent-graduate program of several data projects addressing live business opportunities. It says participants become eligible for full-time data science and analytics roles across the enterprise, with cohorts starting in February and August.

sources.title: Equal opportunity employer and accommodation process
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra states that employment decisions are based on individual merit, qualifications and competence, references pay-transparency protections, and routes accommodation requests to a named recruiting contact while warning applicants not to use that line for application-status questions.

sources.title: NextEra Energy leadership biographies and recent succession
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra's leadership page records recent succession: the CEO since 2022 also chairs FPL and XPLR Infrastructure, a vice chairman was appointed in May 2026, and FPL's CEO moved from president to CEO in May 2026. The published biographies emphasize finance, legal, regulatory-testimony and capital-planning experience.

culture_principles.name: Excellence, integrity, and respect
culture_principles.description: NextEra Energy names excellence, integrity, and respect as core values and says its leaders are expected to embody them while building an environment where innovation and people are valued.

culture_principles.name: Big goals with continuous improvement
culture_principles.description: Company career material says its culture centers on setting big goals and continuous improvement, reinforced by Hack Week, an innovation summit, and an in-house startup hub.

culture_principles.name: Different perspectives as an operating input
culture_principles.description: NextEra Energy says embracing differences fuels innovation and better decisions, and points to 14 employee resource groups that advise on evolving the culture.

culture_principles.name: Reliability and customer value at scale
culture_principles.description: Public pages connect utility and field work to reliable, affordable electricity for millions of customers, framing operational and engineering choices as customer-serving work.

culture_principles.name: Interns treated as future employees
culture_principles.description: NextEra Energy says it regards every intern as a potential full-time employee and designs the program around developing talent and identifying future hires.

culture_principles.name: Military experience as a capability source
culture_principles.description: The company describes veterans as integral to its culture because of discipline, creativity, and technical expertise, and backs that with SkillBridge training and a veteran employee resource group.

culture_principles.name: Candidate protection as part of the employment brand
culture_principles.description: NextEra Energy publishes recruitment-fraud guidance, states that it never requests payment from candidates, and directs candidates to verify through official domains.

culture_principles.name: Rotation as a development method
culture_principles.description: NextEra frames several early-career paths as multi-year rotations across teams and work groups, presenting breadth as the way new graduates choose a direction rather than committing to one specialty immediately.

culture_principles.name: Commitments made during major change
culture_principles.description: In announcing the proposed combination with Dominion Energy, NextEra Energy described post-close job, compensation, and benefits protection for Dominion Energy employees, continued local leadership and teams in Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, and increased community giving. The commitments are public; how they would apply to specific teams or to NextEra Energy employees is not specified in the release.

culture_principles.name: Growth targets with stated assumptions
culture_principles.description: NextEra pairs an 8%+ adjusted EPS growth target through 2032, extended to 2035, with a cautionary list naming merger approvals, rate-case outcomes, litigation, policy, weather, and supply-chain assumptions. The framing presents targets as conditional rather than guaranteed.

culture_principles.name: Learning infrastructure open to everyone
culture_principles.description: NextEra describes NextEra University as more than 1,500 courses available to all employees, alongside tuition assistance for degrees, mentorship and special assignments, framing development as an operating investment rather than a perk.

culture_principles.name: Support that starts on day one
culture_principles.description: Benefits are described as beginning on the first day and cover health, retirement with both 401(k) match and pension, parental leave, tuition, adoption and well-being, with on-site services where available.

culture_principles.name: Reliability and affordability stated as operating commitments
culture_principles.description: The power-delivery material quantifies the system it runs, more than 12 million customers across 35,550 square miles with over 880 substations and 80,000 miles of distribution lines, and ties the work to reliability strategy and a hardened grid.

culture_principles.name: Succession from inside the operating companies
culture_principles.description: Leadership biographies show movement between the parent company, FPL and the resources business, with finance, legal, regulatory-testimony and capital-planning experience recurring across the top roles.

culture_principles.name: Accommodation handled through a defined channel
culture_principles.description: NextEra separates accommodation requests from application-status questions and states that employment decisions rest on merit, qualifications and competence.

hiring_signals.signal: Prepares for structured aptitude and job-knowledge testing rather than assuming interviews are only conversational.
Shows safety-first and reliability-minded judgment when describing operational decisions under time pressure.
Demonstrates continuous learning and a pattern of raising performance rather than settling on current methods.
For technical and field roles, explains practical electrical, mechanical, or plant fundamentals through hands-on examples.
Meets the stated academic and work-authorization baseline and applies early in the fall window for summer internships.
Connects military or technical service experience to energy operations, safety, and team leadership in civilian terms.
Shows sustained interest in an energy career rather than a single summer role, consistent with the intern-to-full-time pipeline.
Verifies recruiters, domains, and process steps through official channels before sharing personal data.
For data-analytics early-career roles, points to concrete analytics projects and the tools used, such as Python, SQL, or R, rather than coursework alone.
Explains how they became productive in an unfamiliar team, technology, or shift pattern, and what they delivered during that rotation.
For engineering early-career roles, connects academic or internship work to power delivery, grid, or generation problems rather than to energy interest in general.
Shows how they have delivered through approvals, integration uncertainty, or organizational change without overstating what was settled.

Uses operating evidence, such as backlog additions, restoration speed, or capital employed, to explain how a project created a measurable system outcome rather than describing intent or mission alone.
When discussing a role affected by the Dominion combination, distinguishes what is approved, what remains under regulatory review, and what is a post-close commitment.
Connects engineering or operational work to a published reliability, cost, or customer metric and explains the mechanism behind it.
Explains how monitoring or predictive analytics prevented a failure, including the signal used and the false positives tolerated.
For field or power-delivery roles, shows safety and restoration judgment under real operating constraints rather than equipment familiarity alone.
Names what they studied through employer-supported education or internal courses and how it changed their work.
Explains a recent-graduate program project as a real business problem with an owner and a decision, not a training exercise.
For leadership-track answers, shows how they handled regulatory scrutiny or defended a decision with cost and customer impact.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Assuming the process is an unstructured conversation with no assessment or job-knowledge component.
anti_signals.risk_reason: NextEra Energy publishes that several roles use consistently administered pre-employment tests, so preparation that ignores assessment steps may misrepresent readiness; this is a preparation signal, not an official disqualifier.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Clean-energy enthusiasm that never connects to reliability, affordability, regulation, or customer impact.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Company material consistently frames energy work through reliability and customer value alongside innovation, so mission-only answers miss the operating context the sources describe.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating innovation as novelty without evidence of disciplined execution or continuous improvement.
anti_signals.risk_reason: NextEra Energy pairs innovation language with continuous improvement, structured programs, and operational outcomes rather than novelty for its own sake.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating a chat-only interview, a payment request, or a lookalike email domain as a legitimate NextEra process.
anti_signals.risk_reason: NextEra Energy states that it never asks candidates for money or cryptocurrency and lists chat-only interviews and similar domains as fraud indicators.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Assuming a summer internship converts automatically or that the hiring timeline is flexible.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The company says interns are regarded as potential full-time employees and that it aims to fill summer roles between December and February, which implies a competitive, date-bound process.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Presenting veteran status or mission enthusiasm without operational examples.
anti_signals.risk_reason: NextEra Energy frames veteran value in terms of discipline, technical expertise, and on-the-job training rather than identity alone, so examples carry the claim.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating an early-career program as a single fixed team or specialty from day one.
anti_signals.risk_reason: NextEra describes its digital and finance early-career programs as rotations across work groups, so a fixed-specialty expectation may not match how those programs are structured; this is a preparation signal, not an official disqualifier.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Describing data or analytics interest without any example project, tool, or result.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The Ignite Data Analytics program explicitly asks for coding ability and a portfolio of sample projects that demonstrate analytic acumen.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Speaking about the NextEra Energy-Dominion Energy combination as a completed merger with known team, role, or location outcomes.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The companies describe a proposed combination expected to close in 12 to 18 months, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. The cited release does not specify how most teams or roles would be combined, so treating the deal as settled overstates what is public.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Assuming transaction-related job protections or leadership continuity apply the same way across both companies.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The release states job, compensation, and benefits protection for Dominion Energy employees and names leaders for the combined company, but it does not describe equivalent protections or reporting lines for NextEra Energy employees. The asymmetry is a reason to ask, not a conclusion.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Presenting growth plans tied to the combination without acknowledging approval, integration, or retention risk.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The release's own forward-looking risk language names approval delays or conditions, failure to realize expected benefits, management distraction, and difficulty hiring or retaining employees. A plan that assumes a clean, on-time close is not evidence-based.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating the 36.7 GW backlog or the 8%+ EPS growth target as settled outcomes rather than company targets exposed to approvals, weather, rate decisions, and integration risk.
anti_signals.risk_reason: NextEra's own cautionary statements say results depend on regulatory approvals, rate-case outcomes, policy, weather, and integration, so presenting targets as guarantees overstates what the company has committed.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Describing storm response as a purely heroic surge without naming pre-positioning, mutual assistance, safety sequencing, or restoration measurement.
anti_signals.risk_reason: FPL's storm notice describes structured preparation, external crews, and safety guidance, so a hero narrative without operating discipline misses the evidence the company publishes.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Describing reliability or safety only in slogan terms, with no operating metric or failure example.
anti_signals.risk_reason: NextEra publishes concrete system scale and reliability framing, so abstraction is weaker than the company's own level of detail.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating an internal course catalog or tuition benefit as evidence of capability without showing what was applied.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The growth page presents courses and tuition as investment; the implied test is what the learning changed in the work.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Sending accommodation or application-status questions to the recruiting line that NextEra says is only for support requests.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The equal-opportunity page explicitly separates accommodation requests from status inquiries.
